statement: Use interface list infrastructure through shared UI infrastructure (3 operators in bpy.ops.uilist): every member behaves as in Blender 5.3 and is covered by common tests instead of one test per operator.
notes: UI-infrastructure group row. Member operators (3): bpy.ops.uilist.entry_add = Add Entry; bpy.ops.uilist.entry_move = Move Entry; bpy.ops.uilist.entry_remove = Remove Selected Entry
